comment: Sprint 1 selection: pin key -> Freesound sound id. All ids verified CC0/CC-BY with geotag inside bbox lon 12-20, lat 41.5-46.5 on 2026-11-18 via the Freesound API. Display text states the ACTUAL recording location (rule 9, docs/sourcing.md). zadar-organ has no CC0/CC-BY recording in the bbox and stays 'not yet recorded'.

pins.name: Wind in the rigging
pins.desc: A working north-easterly worrying the masts and halyards in the marina — the same voice the bura has in Senj.

pins.name: Tide between the rocks
pins.desc: Sea tides bubbling in and out between limestone rocks in a small village cove, recorded summer 2025.

pins.name: Bells and cicadas in Betina
pins.desc: A lazy summer afternoon: church bells over the harbor and cicadas in the stone pine shade.

pins.name: Old-town murmur with gulls
pins.desc: Soundscape of the old town Starigrad on Pag after sunset: sheep, crickets, birds, seagulls, people.

pins.name: Evening on the promenade
pins.desc: Around 6 p.m. in the Lapad district: evening town ambience as the day cools off.

pins.name: Island channel ambience
pins.desc: Boat life in the Brijuni channel off the Istrian coast: engines, water, gulls.

pins.name: Open-sea swell
pins.desc: Small waves breaking close to the microphone in the open south Adriatic — nothing but water and wind.

pins.name: Old town at dusk
pins.desc: Recorded between 5 and 7 p.m. on the Walls of Dubrovnik's Old Town: the city exhaling after the day.

pins.name: Ferry with gulls aboard
pins.desc: A car ferry crossing the Kvarner channel: deck rumble, seagulls and people, recorded on board.

pins.name: Crickets at night
pins.desc: Full-summer night soundfield in the forest on the hill above the village of Dramalj.

pins.name: Cicadas in the pines
pins.desc: Cicada orni singing from a vacation on the island of Brač, Croatia, 2013.
